name: Haggai
title: Haggai — Rebuild the House
audience: Returnees who quit the temple for paneled houses.
purpose: Restart temple work; promise greater glory.
christ: Desire of nations / greater glory — temple filled in Him; Zerubbabel’s seal in Davidic line.
spirit: LORD stirs the spirit of leaders and remnant (1:14).
jesus_in_this_book: Desire of nations / greater glory — temple filled in Him; Zerubbabel’s seal in Davidic line.
how_to_read: Check your calendar and budget against God’s house.
watchman_charge: Stop saying “the time is not yet.” Build what God ordered.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
